# withPICA

withPICA is a music rights and catalog platform for managing works, recordings, credits, agreements, royalties, collaborators, and related assets.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/withpica/.

## Actions

- **Get Current User** (read-only): Return the connected withPICA user's profile and linked catalog person ID.
- **Get Person** (read-only): Return detailed catalog information for one person by ID.
- **Get Workspace Context** (read-only): Return the connected organisation, catalog counts, health summary, and current priorities.
- **List Agreement Templates** (read-only): Return the active and system agreement templates available to the organisation.
- **List Agreements** (read-only): Search and filter agreements, including signature and expiry states, one page at a time.
- **List People** (read-only): Search and filter people in the organisation's catalog, returning one page and a continuation cursor.
- **List Projects** (read-only): Return a bounded list of projects in the connected organisation.
- **List Sessions** (read-only): Return a bounded list of recording or creative sessions in the connected organisation.
- **List Works** (read-only): Return a bounded page of musical works in the organisation's catalog.
- **Search Recordings** (read-only): Search recordings by title, artist name, or ISRC and return one result page with recovery guidance.
